defects.title: An exchange that can both take up and secrete is returned twice
defects.trigger: an exchange in Ex_Rxns whose FVA range includes values below -1e-6 and above 1e-6
defects.observed: R2025a, gurobi: {'EX_a';'EX_b';'EX_a';'EX_b'}: line 44 concatenates OptUptake and OptSecr and a reversible exchange is in both
defects.expected: each exchange that is neither obligate uptake nor obligate secretion once

defects.title: Ex_Rxns given as a row vector gives a matrix of names or stops
defects.trigger: Ex_Rxns as a row cell array (help: 'Vector of exchange reactions')
defects.observed: 2x2 cell {'EX_a','EX_b';'EX_a','EX_b'} for {'EX_a','EX_b'}; 'Dimensions of arrays being concatenated are not consistent.' at line 37 for a six-exchange row
defects.expected: the same list as for the column vector

defects.title: The documented option parFVA has no effect
defects.observed: parFVA is only compared with 0 (line 25) and sets the unused variable matlabpool; line 32 is the same call for every parFVA (same result as parFVA = 0)

notes: Repro: model = createModel({'EX_a';'EX_b';'T'}, {'';'';''}, {'a[e] <=> ';'b[e] <=> ';'a[e] <=> b[e]'}, 'printLevel', 0); model.c(:) = 0; findOptExchRxns(model, {'EX_a';'EX_b'}) -> {'EX_a';'EX_b';'EX_a';'EX_b'}; findOptExchRxns(model, {'EX_a','EX_b'}) -> 2x2 cell. With T irreversible (changeRxnBounds(model,'T',0,'l')) the column call gives {'EX_a';'EX_b'} (correct). Blocked exchanges ([0,0]) are not returned, which the help ('neither obligate uptake nor obligate secretion') does not settle; not recorded. A char Ex_Rxns ('EX_bi') returns [] through the else branch (line 46) because length of the char differs from the FVA rows; a char is not a vector of reactions: not recorded. Reach: the duplicate defect is reached on normal inputs (any reversible exchange): default seed; its only src caller generateCompactExchModel is already BLOCKED and compares length(OptExchRxns) between iterations, so the duplicates change its stopping test. Severity of the duplicates (wrong-result vs cosmetic) and of the ignored parFVA (unusable-option, precedent addAnnotations) are for the lead to confirm.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: an exchange that can take up and secrete is returned twice; row Ex_Rxns fails; parFVA ignored (writer reproduced); default reach

defects.title: The third column of boundsW and boundsM holds the minimum fluxes instead of the maximum fluxes
defects.trigger: any call requesting boundsW or boundsM

defects.title: Constraints for only one strain stop the function although the help asks for at least one
defects.trigger: constrW or constrM omitted or empty
defects.observed: error 'OptForce: You should specify constraints for at least one strain' at line 82 for FVAOptForce(model, constrW) and FVAOptForce(model, [], constrM); line 81 uses || instead of &&, lines 86 and 109 unreachable
defects.expected: a missing constraint structure means no constraint for that strain (help: at least one strain)

defects.title: The help describes maxFluxesM as the minimum values of the wild-type strain
defects.observed: 'minimum values for reactions in the wild-type strain'
defects.expected: maximum values for reactions in the mutant strain

notes: Repro: model = createModel({'EX_a';'EX_b';'T'}, {'';'';''}, {'a[e] <=> ';'b[e] <=> ';'a[e] <=> b[e]'}, 'printLevel', 0); model.c(:) = 0; model = changeRxnBounds(model, 'T', 0, 'l'); [minW, maxW, minM, maxM, boundsW, boundsM] = FVAOptForce(model, struct('rxnList',{{'T'}},'rxnValues',4,'rxnBoundType','u'), struct('rxnList',{{'T'}},'rxnValues',2,'rxnBoundType','l')) -> boundsW(:,3) == boundsW(:,2) == num2cell(minW). Reach: no src caller (callers column empty; testOptForce and the findMust* repros use it with both structures and only 2 outputs). Seed suggestion: the boundsW/boundsM defect is confined to calls requesting 5-6 outputs, the error to calls omitting a structure; no src caller makes either: NONE. testOptForce.m calls FVAOptForce as a set-up helper (tests optForce), so a new file was written. The minimum/maximum flux vectors themselves looked right (gurobi).
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: column 3 of boundsW/boundsM holds the minimum (lines 145, 159); one-strain constraints stop at line 82 (writer reproduced); no src caller

notes: drugTable.txt is not shipped with the toolbox (the caller runTestsOnModel checks exist('drugTable.txt','File') first). Hermetic data table written by hand in a tempname folder (the function reads the table by a fixed file name from the current folder or from inputDataFolder); hand-built createModel model; expected lists derived by hand from the network. Passed with gurobi and glpk. Exempt: the initCobraToolbox line (runs when CBT_LP_SOLVER is empty; resets path/solver state and saves the path; precedent testGetDistributedModelFolder), the pre-R2020a branches, and the fastFVA call lines (the call completes only with IBM CPLEX; a statement that errors is not counted as covered). fastFVA observation (callee, not a defect of this function): fastFVA stops with 'Your input reaction vector is not sorted' whenever the alphabetical rxnsInModel (intersect) differs from the model order, so the fallback to fluxVariability is taken; the test orders the model so that this happens on every machine. On this machine fastFVA actually RUNS when the order matches (probe: cplexFVA128 mex with the CPLEX 12.10 found through ILOG_CPLEX_PATH, although COBRA lists ibm_cplex as unavailable), and the results were the same. fastFVA also calls rng('shuffle') and cd(CBTDIR) before it stops; the function restores the folder (checked), the test restores the rng state. Not recorded as defects: a TruePositive/FalseNegative metabolite missing from database.metabolites stops the name lookup (the documented database is the full rBioNet database); a call with fewer than 3 inputs fails on the undefined biomassReaction before the 'nargin < 3' test (all inputs are documented as required). Output orientation (row or column cell) varies with the union calls; the help only says cell array.

defects.title: A product secreted only through a second or third exchange is in neither output list
defects.trigger: a product with several exchanges (e.g. Folate: EX_fol(e), EX_5mthf(e), EX_thf(e)) whose first exchange cannot carry flux while another can
defects.observed: R2025a, gurobi: tp = 0x1 empty, fn = 0x0 empty although the function's FVA gives maxFlux 0 for EX_fol(e) and 1000 for EX_5mthf(e); line 146 keeps only intersect(allEx{1}, flux), line 144 is skipped because another exchange carries flux
defects.expected: Folate is a true positive (help: secretions the model can secrete; comment lines 122-126: with several exchanges at least one should carry flux)

notes: Repro (cwd = sb = tempname folder): m = createModel({'EX_glc_D(e)';'GLCt';'bio1';'EX_fol(e)';'EX_5mthf(e)';'MTHFsec'}, repmat({''},6,1), {'glc_D[e] <=> ';'glc_D[e] -> glc_D[c]';'glc_D[c] -> ';'fol[e] <=> ';'5mthf[e] <=> ';'glc_D[c] -> 5mthf[e]'}, 'printLevel', 0); db.metabolites = {'fol','Folate';'5mthf','5-Methyltetrahydrofolate'}; write sb/secretionProductTable.txt = 'MicrobeID<TAB>Folate\nMicrobe_A<TAB>1\n'; [tp, fn] = testSecretionProducts(m, 'Microbe_A', 'bio1', db, sb) -> both empty; then clear global additionalSecretionRxns (the function's global statement creates it). Reach: data-dependent, not a call form: default seed (callers performDataDrivenRefinement, reportPDF, runTestsOnModel). Other observations for a later test: the shipped papers/2021_demeter/input/secretionProductTable.txt has headers that match no corrRxns name ('Dimethylamine'; 'L-glutamate', 'L-glutamine', 'L-alanine' vs corrRxns 'L-Glutamate', 'L-Glutamine', 'L-Alanine'), so those products are silently never checked (lines 89/132 find nothing); lines 94 and 96 (pre-R2020a branch) print without semicolons; the global additionalSecretionRxns is created by the function and must be removed by a test. A full passing draft was probed: TP {'R-Acetoin'} via additionalSecretionRxns, FN {'Biotin','Thiamin'} (not in model / blocked), Ref column removal, fastFVA fallback as in the other five rows.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: a product secreted only through a later exchange is in neither list (lines 142-147; writer reproduced); default reach; graded as testMetaboliteUptake
